1649  000521  % IOX 302 READ CONSOLE INPUT STATUS
1650  000521  %CC UART STATUS REG IN (P-REG). FE=BIT5,PE=BIT3,OR=BIT4.

1734  000542  %***********************************************
1735  000542  %IOX 303 WRITE CONSOLE INPUT CONTROL
1736  000542  %CC MACRO STATUS WORD UPON ENTRY:
1737  000542  %CC PIN=BIT0,WORD LENGTH =BIT12,11,STOP BITS=BIT13,CHECK PARITY=BIT14
1738  000542  %CC WORD LENGTH 5 => 1 1 0=>1.5 STOP BITS
1739  000542  %CC WORD LENGTH 6 => 1 0 0=>2 STOP BITS
1740  000542  %CC WORD LENGTH 7 => 0 1 0=>2 STOP BITS
1741  000542  %CC WORD LENGTH 8 => 0 0 0=>2 STOP BITS
1742  000542  %CC PARITY IS EVEN
1743  000542  %CC OTHER BITS 0.
1744  000542  %CC UART MODE REG 1: CHECK PARITY=BIT4,WORD LENGTH=BIT2,3 INVERTED
1745  000542  %CC STOP BITS=BIT7,6. 01=1 STOP BIT,10=1.5 STOP BITS, 11=2 STOP BITS.
1746  000542  %CC BIT0=0,BIT1=1,BIT5=1 ALWAYS. (EVEN PARITY,ASYNC. 16XBAUD RATE FACT.)
1747  000542  
1748  000542  TRM3:   IDBS,ALU                                ALUD,NONE
1749  000542   COND,F=0                                       F,NEXT      F,HOLD
1750  000542                                                  T,NEXT      T,HOLD;

10471  004054  %*****************************************************************
10472  004054  %*****************************************************************
10473  004054  %
10474  004054  % INSTRUCTIONS TO SPEED UP SINTRAN III SEGMENT HANDLING %
10475  004054  % THE INSTRUCTION GROUP 'SJSEG' OPCODE 1403XX %
10476  004054  %
10477  004054  %*****************************************************************
10478  004054  %*****************************************************************
10479  004054  %
10480  004054  % OPCODE 140300 : SETPT                                 %
10481  004054  %
10482  004054  % SETPT: JXZ * 10 % FINISHED                            %
10483  004054  % LDDTIX 20                                             %
10484  004054  % BSET ZRO 130 DA % PGU-BIT                             %
10485  004054  % LDBTX 10                                              %
10486  004054  % 177777 % OLD BUG IN LDBTX                             %
10487  004054  % STD ,B % ALWAYS INSIDE PAGE TABLE                     %
10488  004054  % LDDTIX 00                                             %
10489  004054  % JMP * -7                                              %
10490  004054  %
10491  004054  %********************************************************%
10492  004054  %
10493  004054  % OPCODE 140301 : CLEPT                                 %
10494  004054  %
10495  004054  % CLEPT: JXZ * 11 % FINISHED                            %
10496  004054  % LDBTX 10                                              %
10497  004054  % 177777 % OLD BUG IN LDBTX                             %
10498  004054  % LDA ,B                                                %
10499  004054  % JAZ * 3                                               %
10500  004054  % STATX 20 % ALWAYS INSIDE PAGE TABLE                   %
10501  004054  % STZ ,B                                                %
10502  004054  % LDDTIX 00                                             %
10503  004054  % JMP * -10                                             %
10504  004054  %
10505  004054  %********************************************************%
10506  004054  %
10507  004054  % OPCODE 140302 : CLNREENT                              %
10508  004054  %
10509  004054  % READ ADDRESS A+2 TO FIND PAGE TABLE TO BE AFFECTED    %
10510  004054  % READ RT-DESCRIPTION BITMAP WORDS. FOUND FROM ADDRESS X+25. %
10511  004054  % CLEAR PAGE-TABLE ENTRIES CORRESPONDING TO 1-BITS IN BITMAP. %
10512  004054  % THE LAST BITMAP-ADDRESS IS IN ADDRESS X+T.            %
10513  004054  %
10514  004054  %********************************************************%
10515  004054  %
10516  004054  % OPCODE 140303 ; CHREENTPAGES
10517  004054  %
10518  004054  %  1. READ ADDRESS D,X -> R1 ; D,X -> PREVIOUS (SCRATCH REG)
10519  004054  %  2. IF R1 = 0: SKIP RETURN (FINISHED)
10520  004054  %  3. READ ADDRESS T,R1+2
10521  004054  %  4. IF NOT WIF; T,R1 -> PREVIOUS; READ ADDR T,R1 -> R1; GOTO 2
10522  004054  %  5. READ ADDRESS T,R1 -> R2
10523  004054  %  6. WRITE R2 -> ADDRESS PREVIOUS
10524  004054  %  7. R1 -> X ; PREVIOUS -> D,A ; RETURN
10525  004054  %
10526  004054  %***********************************************************************
10527  004054  %
10528  004054  % OPCODE 140304 ; CLEUP
10529  004054  %
10530  004054  % AS 'CLEPT', BUT INCLUDING WORKING SET INFORMATION
10531  004054  % FOR ALL PAGE-TABLE ENTRIES HANDLED
10532  004054  % IF PGU OF ENTRY IS 1
10533  004054  %   D /1 300
10534  004054  %   B /1 776 SHR 1 - D
10535  004054  %   B-REG BITS 0-3 IS NOW BIT NUMBER
10536  004054  %   B-REG BITS 4-6 IS NOW WORD NUMBER
10537  004054  %   SET BIT IN 8-WORD TABLE IN PAGE-MAP BANK
10538  004054  %   POINTED TO BY L-REGISTER
10539  004054  %
10540  004054  % LAYOUT OF 8-WORD TABLE :
10541  004054  %
10542  004054  %   BIT 15                                             BIT 0
10543  004054  %   -----------------------------------------------
10544  004054  % L-REG -> WORD 0 # PAGE 17                             PAGE 0 #
10545  004054  %   WORD 1 # PAGE 37                                   20 #
10546  004054  %   WORD 2 # PAGE 57                                   40 #
10547  004054  %   .
10548  004054  %   WORD 7 # PAGE 177                                  160 #
10549  004054  %   .
10550  004054  %   -----------------------------------------------
10551  004054  %
10552  004054  %***********************************************************************
10553  004054  %***********************************************************************
10554  004054  %
